model: Something I lost and never found was a small black notebook, which I'd used for about four years to write down ideas, quotes and plans. It wasn't worth any money, but it was full of personal things, including notes from the day I started my first job. I lost it on a trip to Hanoi about a year ago. I took it out on the train to write something, and I'm fairly sure I put it on the seat next to me. When I got to the hotel, I opened my bag and had a sinking feeling, because it wasn't there. I turned the place upside down, emptying every pocket and even checking under the bed. The next morning I went back to the station and retraced my steps, from the platform to the taxi rank. I also went to the lost property office, and the man there looked through a huge box of umbrellas and phones, but there was no notebook. It seemed to have vanished into thin air. I called the railway company twice more that week, but eventually I gave up hope. Honestly, I felt sad for days, because I'd lost a big part of my memories. I've always been a bit absent-minded, so I suppose I learned my lesson. Now I write everything in an app, and it's automatically backed up online.
